sources.title: A Neural Probabilistic Language Model
locators: Section 1.1, jointly learning features and probability-function parameters
sources.boundedClaim: The model jointly learns word features and neural next-word parameters. It reports random word-feature initialization similar to neural-network weights. This is not evidence for this course's exact generator, seed, naming or dimension-aware policy.
sources.shortExactExcerpt: Random initialization of the word features was done (similarly to initialization of neural network weights)

sources.title: Understanding the difficulty of training deep feedforward neural networks
locators: Section 4.3, limits of linearity/independence during learning
sources.boundedClaim: Under simplifying independence and near-linear assumptions, forward fan-in and backward fan-out variance constraints motivate a compromise variance 2/(fan_in+fan_out) and a zero-centered uniform bound sqrt(6/(fan_in+fan_out)). This is not a universal nonlinear decoder stability theorem.

sources.title: Attention Is All You Need
locators: Section 3.4, learned embeddings and embedding forward scaling
sources.boundedClaim: Transformer layers repeat learned attention and feed-forward projections and use learned token embeddings. Its attention and embedding forward scaling must not be confused with this course's initialization policy; the paper does not prescribe this initializer.
